name: gizza-ai/spritesheet-to-gif
summary: Combine a grid sprite sheet's frames into one animated GIF.

tool.description: Combine a grid sprite sheet's frames into a single animated GIF. Describe the grid either by columns + rows, or by tile_width + tile_height (fixed-size tiles); margin (outer border) and spacing (gap between frames) default to 0. Frames are taken in row-major (left-to-right, top-to-bottom) order. delay_ms sets the per-frame delay (default 100ms, 10ms granularity), loop_count controls repeats (0 = forever), skip_empty drops fully-transparent cells, and max_frames caps how many frames are used. Provide the sheet as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

columns.description: Number of columns in the grid. Pair with rows (grid mode).

rows.description: Number of rows in the grid. Pair with columns (grid mode).

tile_width.description: Frame width in pixels. Pair with tile_height (tile-size mode).

tile_height.description: Frame height in pixels. Pair with tile_width (tile-size mode).

margin.description: Border in pixels around all four edges of the sheet.

spacing.description: Gap in pixels between adjacent frames.

skip_empty.description: Drop frames that are fully transparent (every pixel alpha 0).

loop_count.description: Times to repeat: 0 loops forever, N plays N+1 times then stops.

max_frames.description: Stop after this many frames (default: all cells).
